paragraphs: (A Tanna.) He is mentioned in [Chullin 55b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.55b.13), testifying with Yochanan ben Gurgadah that a flayed animal is unfit.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Chullin 55b writes Yochanan ben Gudgeda (גודגדא), whereas Hyman supplies Gurgadah (גורגדה). The source’s name form is retained alongside the witness difference.

The linked Gemara names Elazar the Scribe and Yochanan ben Gudgeda as witnesses. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=516&lang=en) gives the same pairing. Hyman writes Gurgadah.
